SCI-FRUIT v0.1 r0.4 — FINAL STAGE A
MODEL-ROLE, LINEARITY, METHOD-IDENTITY, AND PACKET-CLOSURE REPAIR

The SCI-FRUIT r0.3 scope architecture is accepted as the basis for one final
micro-repair.

The distinction among:

A. program-order authority;
B. conditional scientific-composition authority; and
C. numerical FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD authority

is correct and shall be preserved.

Do not perform another broad Stage A derivation.

Preserve:

- no numerical method selection;
- no Stage B launch before exact packet approval;
- the typed remove -> residual process -> rejoin composition;
- immutable original measured-parent ancestry;
- no default iteration-input rule;
- distinct continuation, restart, branch, retry, relearning, completion, and
  terminal selection;
- operation-level fixed/recomputed/relearned state;
- grouping as method identity;
- path-specific support and information origin;
- model-only content as model/prior-supported and not acquired exposure;
- separate response and uncertainty families;
- complete covariance cross terms;
- SCI-VAL evaluation without SCI-VAL ownership or execution of recurrence;
- terminal selection as a separate immutable reference to a completed
  iteration;
- FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD as unavailable pending separate owner approval;
- every present nonclaim.

======================================================================
1. KEEP CANDIDATE, ACCEPTED, AND APPLIED MODELS DISTINCT
======================================================================

The r0.3 opening correctly says that candidate, accepted, and applied models
are different scientific objects, but the typed algebra later uses one m_k as
both accepted and applied.

Define separately:

    m_k^candidate
    m_k^accepted
    m_k^applied.

Use the applied model in the scientific composition:

    rho_k
      = y_k^in - Pi_k(m_k^applied)

    z_k
      = F_k(rho_k) + B_k(m_k^applied).

If a method establishes:

    m_k^applied = m_k^accepted,

record that as an exact method/state equality.

Any normalization, clipping, sign conversion, support restriction, projection,
unit conversion, or other transformation between acceptance and application
shall be explicit.

A generic iteration transition may be written as:

    (S_k, y_k^in)
      ->
    (m_k^candidate,
     m_k^accepted,
     m_k^applied,
     rho_k,
     z_k,
     S_(k+1)),

with typed not_applicable or unavailable states where a role does not occur.

Update the scope brief, notation taxonomy, lifecycle table, method-record
template, iteration bundle, response table, uncertainty table, and predictions.

======================================================================
2. REPAIR THE FIXED-LINEAR EXPANSION
======================================================================

When only F_k is known to be fixed and linear, use:

    z_k
      =
      A_k y_k^in
      - A_k[Pi_k(m_k^applied)]
      + B_k(m_k^applied).

Do not call:

    B_k - A_k Pi_k

a linear model-path operator unless Pi_k and B_k are also declared linear on
the stated model space.

Only under exact linearity of A_k, Pi_k, and B_k define:

    D_k = B_k - A_k o Pi_k

and:

    z_k = A_k y_k^in + D_k m_k^applied.

Bind domains, codomains, units, support, state, and conditioning for every
composition.

If Pi_k or B_k is nonlinear, retain the map-valued expression and do not apply
linear response or covariance formulas by implication.

======================================================================
3. SEPARATE METHOD IDENTITY FROM REALIZED STATE
======================================================================

Replace the statement that every recomputed coefficient itself requires a new
method identity.

Use:

    A change to the coefficient-recomputation rule, learning rule, operator
    family, role order, sign, bypass graph, support rule, recurrence, grouping,
    stopping rule, or terminal-selection rule creates a new method identity.

    Different coefficient values, learned states, accepted models, or applied
    models produced under one unchanged method create distinct state,
    iteration, and application generations.

A fixed-subspace/recomputed-coefficient method therefore retains one method
identity while publishing a new exact coefficient/application state for each
realization or iteration.

Do not collapse a rule change into a state change, and do not create a new
method merely because an approved iterative rule produced another numerical
state.

======================================================================
4. MAKE THE PARENT QUANTITY ROUTE-CONDITIONAL
======================================================================

Do not define the generic measured parent through one PTC-to-MAP mJy/beam
convention while also stating that no parent route is selected.

Use:

    Every selected parent route supplies its exact quantity, unit, frame,
    response, beam/template convention, calibration, support, validity,
    lifecycle, and provenance.

    If the selected route is the ordinary PTC-to-MAP route, retain that route's
    exact currently authorized quantity and originating nominal-beam/calibration
    lineage.

    That conditional example does not establish Stokes I, true sky, a generic
    FRUIT target, or a universal input unit.

    This Stage A packet selects no parent route.

The future numerical method shall bind one exact parent route and all required
domain conversions. Equal shape or unit labels establish no compatibility.

======================================================================
5. ENUMERATE THE SIX RESPONSE FAMILIES
======================================================================

Do not use “adaptive” as an undefined shorthand.

Name the exact response roles in the scope brief and response table.

At minimum distinguish:

1. fixed one-step measured-input response;
2. fixed one-step model-input response;
3. one-step FRUIT full-procedure response;
4. recursive multi-iteration response;
5. selected-terminal response;
6. whole-chain response.

If FRUIT-full-procedure with the upstream parent held fixed is intended as an
additional distinct role, enumerate it explicitly and reconcile the total
count.

For every role bind:

- what is perturbed;
- what is held fixed;
- what is rerun or relearned;
- baseline and perturbed domains;
- branch/support/selection comparability;
- response codomain;
- unavailable and discontinuity behavior.

An online adaptive filter remains a separately authored estimator and shall not
be introduced through ambiguous response terminology.

======================================================================
6. PRESERVE UNIVERSAL CORE COMPLETION GATES
======================================================================

Clarify:

    The conditional core defines universal minimum bundle structure and hard
    claim dependencies.

    A numerical method may add method-specific required roles and may declare
    which optional companions are necessary for one named result or use.

    It may not waive universal requirements for:

    - immutable parent identity;
    - exact iteration input;
    - accepted and applied model identities;
    - removal, residual-processing, and rejoin roles;
    - iteration result;
    - path support and information origin;
    - lifecycle and causes;
    - state and generation;
    - provenance;
    - truthful response and uncertainty status.

Typed unavailable roles may coexist with a complete iteration only where the
generic core and exact method permit that narrower claim.

Missing science is never zero, identity, successful bypass, or permission to
omit a required role.

======================================================================
7. TYPE THE NUMERICAL-METHOD AUTHORITY AS A FAMILY
======================================================================

Use:

    FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD v0.1

as the required-record schema or authority family.

Every approved numerical method shall receive its own identity:

    FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD/<method-name>@<revision>.

Methods differing in parent route, grouping, recurrence, operator graph,
model construction, coefficient-recomputation rule, support, learning,
stopping, terminal selection, or failure behavior shall not share one method
identity.

No method-specific identity is approved by creating the family record.

The current state remains:

    unavailable_pending_separate_owner_approval.

======================================================================
8. PACKET-CLOSURE CHECK
======================================================================

Return the exact bytes of:

- revised Scope Brief;
- SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md;
- RESPONSE_AND_UNCERTAINTY_FAMILIES.md;
- ITERATION_STATE_LIFECYCLE.md;
- SUPPORT_INFORMATION_ORIGIN.md;
- REQUIRED_CONDITIONAL_PREDICTIONS.md;
- FRUIT_FEEDBACK_METHOD_REQUIRED_RECORD.md;
- NOTATION_AND_ROLE_TAXONOMY.md;
- BOUNDARIES_AND_CONVENTIONS.md;
- frozen PTC fragment and its cover;
- PROGRAM_REFERENCE.md;
- Stage A semantic-change report;
- AUTHOR_INPUT_MANIFEST.md;
- manifest sidecar;
- compressed archive and archive sidecar.

Verify that:

- candidate, accepted, and applied models remain distinct everywhere;
- the linear model-path operator is used only under complete linearity;
- method identity and state generation are never aliases;
- the exact response-family count and names agree;
- all seven state categories are present;
- all eight support/information-origin roles are present;
- complete covariance retains parent-model cross terms;
- all twenty predictions are present and traceable;
- the A/B/C authority distinction is exact;
- every numerical method requires a method-specific identity;
- all hashes reproduce;
- there are no unresolved bundle-local links.

======================================================================
9. STAGE B DISPOSITION
======================================================================

After Grant Wilson approves the exact repaired packet bytes, launch Stage B in
a fresh implementation-blind thread.

Stage B may author and later seek conditional freeze of the generic
SCI-FRUIT core while numerical methods, parents, models, recurrence, stopping,
response, covariance, and downstream use profiles remain unavailable.

It shall not infer a familiar FRUIT algorithm or default.

No Stage A approval or Stage B draft establishes numerical availability,
implementation conformity, recovered sky modes, response/covariance fidelity,
uncertainty coverage, convergence adequacy, Pointing/OOF/catalog fitness,
observational validation, performance, readiness, production suitability,
production authorization, or Unity activity.
